screens.name: Global — Common Elements
screens.note: Patterns that repeat on every page (shared chrome, every data table, every Add button). One fix applies everywhere.

findings.figma: Height 40px, navy #003366 background.
findings.live: Height 38px (colour is correct).
findings.fix: Increase the accessibility bar height from 38px to 40px.

findings.figma: Two lines: 'Ministry of SJE' (14px/500/#1f2937) above the bold 'Department of SJE' headline (20px/700/#374151).
findings.live: Single line 'Ministry of SJE' at 20px/700/#374151 — the Department headline is absent.
findings.fix: Add 'Department of Social Justice & Empowerment' (20px/700/#374151) as the main masthead headline; show the Ministry line above it at 14px/500/#1f2937.

findings.figma: Centre-right of the masthead: Digital India logo + SAMAVESH lockup, with a 24px gap between them.
findings.live: No co-branding — the centre of the header is empty.
findings.fix: Add the Digital India logo and the SAMAVESH lockup to the header centre, before the user profile.

findings.figma: A hamburger/collapse control sits at the top-left of the header.
findings.live: No collapse control is shown in the header.
findings.fix: Add the sidebar collapse (hamburger) control at the header's left edge.

findings.figma: Active item: text #003366 · weight 400 · corner radius 16px · background #e5eff9.
findings.live: Active item: text #374151 · weight 700 · radius 8px (background correct; three properties deviate).
findings.fix: Active sidebar item: text colour → #003366 · weight → 400 · corner radius → 16px.

findings.figma: Name with the role below it as plain text ('Admin', no punctuation); the avatar sits AFTER the text, at the far right.
findings.live: Avatar comes first, then the name; the role is wrapped in parentheses — '(Super Admin)'.
findings.fix: Put the name and role first with the avatar to their right, and show the role as plain text without parentheses.

findings.figma: All inputs and search fields use Noto Sans, like the rest of the portal.
findings.live: Search and text inputs render in Poppins on Login and across the Admin and Ministry screens.
findings.fix: Set every input, select and search field to Noto Sans.

findings.figma: Plus icon to the LEFT of the label; label 14px / 500 / line-height 20; padding 24-left / 16-right / 8 top & bottom; the plus is a separate 16×16 icon.
findings.live: Plus icon to the RIGHT; label 14px / 600 with a tight line-height; padding 18 / 12 / 0; the '+' is baked into the label text.
findings.fix: On every Add button: plus icon on the left, label weight 500 / line-height 20, padding 24/16/8, and a real plus-icon element.

findings.figma: 14px / 600 / colour #6b7280; cell padding 24px on the sides · 16px top & bottom; header sits on a #f9fafb band.
findings.live: Header text renders in #4b5563 with only 14px top/bottom padding (colour and vertical padding deviate; font-size 14px is correct).
findings.fix: On every table header: text colour → #6b7280; cell padding 24px sides · 16px top/bottom.

findings.figma: 14px / 400 / colour #374151; cell padding 24px on the sides · 16px top & bottom.
findings.live: Body cells render with a different colour (#4b5563, or pure #000 on some screens) and less top/bottom padding (16–20px).
findings.fix: On every table body cell: text colour → #374151; cell padding 24px sides · 16px top/bottom.

findings.figma: The search bar and table sit directly on the page with a soft shadow — there is NO bordered card around them.
findings.live: The search and table are wrapped in a 1px hairline-bordered card.
findings.fix: Remove the hairline card border around the search + table; use the soft shadow from the design.

findings.figma: Navy government bar at the very top — flag + 'Government of India', 'Skip to Main Content', A−/A/A+ text resize, contrast toggle and language selector.
findings.live: The login page has no government bar at all (the signed-in pages do have it).
findings.fix: Add the same government accessibility bar to the top of the login page.

findings.figma: Emblem + BETA tag + the full three-line lockup ending in the bold 'Department of Social Justice & Empowerment', plus the Digital India and SAMAVESH logos.
findings.live: Only the emblem with two lines; the BETA tag, Department line and both partner logos are missing.
findings.fix: Show the complete masthead: BETA tag, full department lockup, and the Digital India + SAMAVESH logos.

findings.figma: A solid navy #003366 brand panel (~60% of the page): SAMAVESH logo + समावेश wordmark, orange divider, 'Justice. Equality. Dignity.' headline, a short description, and a bottom 'SIGNING INTO E-Utthaan' strip with a Change button.
findings.live: A pale-blue illustration fills the left side (~44%) — no navy panel, no SAMAVESH branding, no tagline and no 'SIGNING INTO' strip.
findings.fix: Replace the illustration with the navy SAMAVESH brand panel, restore the ~60/40 split and the 'SIGNING INTO E-Utthaan' strip.

findings.figma: 'Log in to your account' — left-aligned at the top of the form.
findings.live: 'Log In' — centred, with the national emblem repeated above it.
findings.fix: Use the heading 'Log in to your account', left-aligned, and remove the duplicate emblem above the form.

findings.figma: 'User ID or Email' and 'Password' labels sit above their fields; inputs are 48px tall with a navy #003366 focus outline.
findings.live: No labels — only placeholder text inside the fields; inputs are 46px tall with no visible focus style.
findings.fix: Add the two field labels above the inputs; input height 48px with a 2px navy #003366 focus outline.

findings.figma: Eye icon inside the password field — 24×24, grey #6b7280.
findings.live: The eye icon is smaller (~16px) and tight against the field edge with a small tap area.
findings.fix: Use the 24px eye icon in grey #6b7280 with a comfortable tap area.

findings.figma: Label 'Log In' · 48px tall · 8px corner radius · full form width.
findings.live: Label 'Sign In' · ~41px tall · ~6px radius.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Log In'; set height 48px and corner radius 8px.

findings.figma: 'Forgot Password?' — with the question mark — right-aligned on the Password label row, in navy.
findings.live: 'Forgot Password' without the question mark.
findings.fix: Add the question mark: 'Forgot Password?'.

findings.figma: Noto Sans 28px / 500 / line-height 36 / letter-spacing −0.28 / colour #374151.
findings.live: 30px / 600 / colour #1E3A5F (larger, bolder and a different colour).
findings.fix: Set the page heading to 28px / 500 / #374151 / letter-spacing −0.28.

findings.figma: The State and Financial-Year filters sit at the top of the page, next to the 'Dashboard' heading — they control everything below.
findings.live: The Financial-Year filter sits inside the 'Progress Report' panel header, although changing it also updates the four KPI cards above it.
findings.fix: Move the Financial-Year filter to the top of the page next to the heading, as it affects the whole page. Applies to the Ministry dashboard as well.

findings.figma: Two filters at the top: a State dropdown ('All States') and the Financial-Year dropdown.
findings.live: Only the Financial-Year filter exists; there is no State filter.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters.

findings.figma: Card label in regular weight (400) dark slate #374151; the value below in semibold dark slate #374151.
findings.live: Card labels render in bold, and all values render in bold navy (#003366 family) — heavier and bluer than the design.
findings.fix: Card labels → regular 400 #374151; values → semibold #374151 (not navy, not extra bold). Applies to both dashboards.

findings.figma: 'Progress Report of Financial Year …' is a plain section title on the page, with the white stat cards directly below it.
findings.live: The whole progress section is wrapped in a grey panel with a header strip, so the cards sit inside a box that isn't in the design.
findings.fix: Remove the grey wrapper panel; show the section title directly on the page with the cards below.

findings.figma: Financial-year body cells use navy #003366 (this screen highlights the value in primary).
findings.live: Body cells render in #374151 — the navy treatment is missing.
findings.fix: Set the body cell text to navy #003366 on this screen.

findings.figma: The right-most column has an 'Action' header above the row controls.
findings.live: No 'Action' header above the edit/delete controls.
findings.fix: Add the 'Action' column header to the table header row.

findings.figma: Two icon-only buttons per row: a pencil (edit) in a light box and a red trash (delete) in a light-red box.
findings.live: An 'Edit' text link with a pencil, plus a bare trash icon — not the boxed icon-only buttons.
findings.fix: Use the boxed icon-only pencil and red trash buttons from the design.

findings.figma: Highlighted/selected row background #e5eff9.
findings.live: Highlighted row background #eaf2fb — visually close but not the token.
findings.fix: Use #e5eff9 for the highlighted row background.

findings.figma: Search field has a white background (border #e5e7eb).
findings.live: Search field background is grey #f9fafb (border #e5e7eb is the same in both).
findings.fix: Set the search field background to white.

findings.figma: Default rows in neutral dark #374151; a row turns primary navy #003366 (on the #e5eff9 highlight) only on hover/selection.
findings.live: Ministry names always render in a lighter blue link style, regardless of state.
findings.fix: Default rows → #374151; apply the navy #003366 treatment only to the hovered/selected row.

findings.figma: On the hovered row: 'Edit' (navy on a light fill, 8px radius) and 'Delete' (red text + icon), comfortably sized with a 12px gap.
findings.live: Edit and Delete appear but are compressed by the tight row padding and can't render at their designed size.
findings.fix: Match the Edit/Delete buttons' size, fill and spacing to the design.

findings.figma: Three filter chips beside the search: Financial Year, 'All Schemes' and 'All Department'.
findings.live: Only the Financial-Year dropdown is present.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters.

findings.figma: A compact filter chip (about 99×36, 6px radius, 1px #e5e7eb border, leading arrow-down icon).
findings.live: A wide clearable select with a trailing × button and chevron — a different control style.
findings.fix: Use the compact filter-chip style from the design; keep the × clear only for an applied-filter state.

findings.figma: A two-option segmented control sits beside the heading — active 'Ministry' in white on navy #003366, inactive 'Schemes' in grey.
findings.live: No tabs at all — the 'Mapped Ministry List' heading sits alone above the table.
findings.fix: Add the Ministry/Schemes segmented tabs beside the heading, as shown in the design.

findings.figma: Body cells use neutral dark #374151.
findings.live: Ministry-name cells render in navy #003366 with a link treatment that isn't in the design.
findings.fix: Set the body cells to #374151; remove the navy link treatment.

findings.figma: 'Unmap' is a quiet text button in navy #003366 (text + icon).
findings.live: 'Unmap' renders in red (~#ef4444) — a danger treatment the design doesn't use.
findings.fix: Recolour the Unmap text and icon to navy #003366.

findings.figma: Three filter dropdowns beside the search field.
findings.live: A single 'All Years' select only.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters.

findings.figma: The filter control uses an 8px corner radius and sits at the top of the page.
findings.live: The Financial-Year selector uses a 6px radius and sits inside the progress panel header (placement covered under Admin · Dashboard).
findings.fix: Set the filter control radius to 8px.

findings.figma: Card label regular 400 #374151; value semibold #374151.
findings.live: Labels bold, values bold navy — same deviation as the Admin dashboard.
findings.fix: Card labels → regular 400 #374151; values → semibold #374151.

findings.figma: An 'All Department' dropdown sits beside the Financial-Year filter.
findings.live: Only the Financial-Year filter is present.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters.

findings.figma: 'All Schemes' and 'All Department' dropdowns sit beside the Financial-Year filter.
findings.live: Only the Financial-Year dropdown is present.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters.

findings.figma: Two actions: 'Import Achievements Data' (outline) and 'Add Progress' (filled navy).
findings.live: A third button — 'Download Sample Template' — appears to the left of Import.
findings.fix: Confirm whether the extra 'Download Sample Template' action is intended; the design shows two actions.
